# WIRED

> WIRED covers the intersection of technology, science, culture, and business with a focus on AI policy, surveillance, energy markets, and Silicon Valley innovation.

WIRED is a leading digital publication delivering breaking tech news, long-form investigative journalism, and expert analysis through multiple formats including articles, podcasts, videos, and newsletters. The site emphasizes critical coverage of emerging technologies like AI, surveillance systems, and EVs alongside cultural commentary and product reviews.

## Key Topics

- AI Technology
- AI Policy & Regulation
- Surveillance & Privacy
- Silicon Valley
- Energy Markets
- Electric Vehicles
- Tech Companies (Meta, Tesla, Amazon, OpenAI)
- Gig Economy
- Prediction Markets
- Current Events & Politics
- Product Reviews
- Investigative Journalism
- Podcasts & Video Content

## News & Investigation

- [Anthropic Denies It Could Sabotage AI Tools During War](https://www.wired.com/story/anthropic-denies-sabotage-ai-tools-war-claude): News article on Anthropic Claude AI regulation and Pentagon national security concerns
- [Iran War Puts Global Energy Markets on the Brink of a Worst-Case Scenario](https://www.wired.com/story/iran-war-puts-global-energy-markets-on-the-brink-of-a-worst-case-scenario): Analysis of Iran-Israel conflict impact on global energy markets and oil prices
- [A Top Democrat Is Urging Colleagues to Support Trump's Spy Machine](https://www.wired.com/story/a-top-democrat-is-urging-colleagues-to-support-trumps-spy-machine): Investigative report on Jim Himes' support for Section 702 surveillance authority
- ['A Rigged and Dangerous Product': The Wildest Week for Prediction Markets Yet](https://www.wired.com/story/why-this-was-the-wildest-week-for-prediction-markets-yet): News on Kalshi prediction markets regulation and Arizona criminal charges
- [I Tried DoorDash's Tasks App and Saw the Bleak Future of AI Gig Work](https://www.wired.com/story/i-tried-doordashs-tasks-app-and-saw-the-bleak-future-of-ai-gig-work): Investigation of DoorDash Tasks app using gig workers to train AI models

## Core Channels & Content Hub

- [WIRED Homepage](https://www.wired.com): WIRED homepage covering tech, science, culture, business news and AI policy
- [Magazine](https://www.wired.com/magazine): WIRED magazine featuring long-form journalism and investigative reporting
- [The Big Interview](https://www.wired.com/the-big-interview): Interview series with tech leaders including OpenAI and ChatGPT discussions
- [Podcasts](https://www.wired.com/podcasts): Podcast hub featuring Uncanny Valley and tech/politics audio content
- [Video](https://www.wired.com/video): Video hub with Big Interview series, celebrity interviews, and AI documentaries
- [Livestream AMAs](https://www.wired.com/livestreams): Livestream AMAs with expert interviews on AI, EVs, and technology news

## Newsletters & Subscriptions

- [Newsletters](https://www.wired.com/newsletter): Newsletter subscription hub featuring daily digests, gear reviews, and AI coverage
- [WIRED Insider](https://www.wired.com/collection/wiredinsider): Sponsored content collection covering AI, healthcare innovation, and enterprise solutions

## Technology & Innovation Coverage

- [How BYD Got EV Chargers to Work Almost as Fast as Gas Pumps](https://www.wired.com/story/how-byds-ev-charger-got-even-faster-and-it-might-not-matter-as-much-as-you-think): Feature on BYD Flash Chargers fast-charging technology and EV infrastructure
- ['Uncanny Valley': Nvidia's 'Super Bowl of AI,' Tesla Disappoints, and Meta's VR Metaverse 'Shutdown'](https://www.wired.com/story/uncanny-valley-podcast-nvidia-gtc-tesla-disappointed-fans-meta-horizon-worlds): Podcast episode covering Nvidia GTC, Tesla, and Meta Horizon Worlds shutdowns

## Culture & Commentary

- ['Jury Duty Presents: Company Retreat' Almost Makes Corporate Culture Seem Fun](https://www.wired.com/story/jury-duty-presents-company-retreat-almost-makes-corporate-culture-seem-fun): Prime Video prank series review examining corporate culture and workplace dynamics

## Optional: Product Reviews & Deals

- [Best Protein Bars (2026): Vegan, Gluten-Free, High Fiber](https://www.wired.com/story/best-protein-bars): Product guide reviewing vegan and gluten-free protein bars with nutrition tips
- [Aiper Scuba V3 Pool Robot Review: Eye on the Prize](https://www.wired.com/review/aiper-scuba-v3-pool-robot): Review of Aiper Scuba V3 AI-powered pool cleaning robot with computer vision
- [This Compact Bose Soundbar Is $80 Off](https://www.wired.com/story/bose-smart-soundbar-deal-326): Deal coverage on discounted Bose Smart Soundbar with Dolby Atmos
- [Best Kids' Bikes (2026): Woom, Prevelo, Guardian, and More](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-kids-bikes): Product roundup of top kids' bikes from Woom, Prevelo, and Guardian Bikes
